description: Assertions for batch analysis, human-readable delivery, and transaction-safe deduplication.
assertions: OpenAI returns exactly one strict-schema result for every supplied itemKey.
Only qualified posts meeting the configured score are saved to Google Sheets.
Telegram receives one digest containing no more than Maximum Alerts Per Digest posts.
All evaluated post keys are committed only after required Sheets and Telegram delivery succeeds.
A duplicate rerun sends no Telegram message and creates no duplicate spreadsheet row.
